name: Combination Discipline — Denial of Aphrodite's Favor

system.description: Developed centuries ago, this combination Discipline protects the Ventrue from the very skills at which they and the Toreador excel. While the powers of Presence may be subtler than those of Dominate, they are no less effective. Once learned, this power negates the effects of Presence powers of Awe, Dread Gaze, and Entrancement (or their equivalents) used against you by any vampire of a higher generation than your own, exactly as your generation already protects you against Dominate.
system.source: Clanbook: Ventrue, Chapter Two: The King is Dead, Long Live the King
